idea: Animals & their sounds #2 (THE ZOO, low wooden fence): a cute baby elephant pops its head up over the zoo fence right beside Baby Ava's face, curly trunk up ('Wow! Look! A baby elephant!'); chorus 'Animal sounds! Sing with me!'; 'The elephant says toot, toot, toot!'; a little monkey on the fence rail – 'Ooh ooh, ah ah!'; a lion cub does a tiny cute roar – 'Roar, roar, roar!'; copy-me 'Scratch your head! Ooh ooh, ah ah!'; she asks the viewer 'Who says toot, toot? Hmm?' (pause) – 'The elephant! Toot, toot! Yay!'; lesson 'Animal sounds at the zoo!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now elephant, monkey and lion cub together, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Three zoo animals and their sounds: elephant – toot, monkey – ooh ooh ah ah, lion – roar.
place: THE ZOO (text-only block, section 4) – first video in this place
calendar: Wednesday slot 1 – Animals & their sounds / nature (#1 was farm sounds on 4 Nov: cow, sheep, hen; today zoo animals).
characters: BABY AVA: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby girl with short fluffy curly brown hair, one small curly ponytail on top with a sparkly pink star hair clip, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks. wearing a soft yellow dress with ruffle sleeves and a small pink flower, and pink baby shoes with bows.
setting: THE ZOO: a friendly sunny zoo with green trees and cute round cartoon animals. (low light-wood zoo fence, soft green grass)

supporting_objects.elephant: THE BABY ELEPHANT: a cute round baby elephant with soft light gray skin, big floppy ears with pink insides, big shiny friendly dark eyes, a short curly trunk and a happy smile; toy-like, never scary.
supporting_objects.monkey: THE LITTLE MONKEY: a cute little round brown monkey with a cream face and cream tummy, big shiny friendly brown eyes, round ears, a happy smile and a long curly tail; toy-like, never scary.
supporting_objects.lion: THE LION CUB: a cute round fluffy golden lion cub with a small soft fluffy mane tuft on his head, big shiny friendly brown eyes, a cream muzzle and round paws; toy-like, cute and never scary.

learning.goal: Name three zoo animals and their sounds: elephant – toot, monkey – ooh ooh ah ah, lion – roar.
learning.shown_how: One animal at a time beside Ava's face behind the zoo fence (elephant, monkey, lion cub) while she copies its sound/action, then all three in a neat row in the sung order.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:21 'Who says toot, toot? Hmm?' + 0:21-0:23 humming pause (question boing) → 0:23 'The elephant! Toot, toot! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: 0:15-0:18 'Scratch your head! Ooh ooh, ah ah!' (shot 2: Ava and the monkey scratch their heads) + 0:12 lion paws
learning.fact_check: Elephant – toot (trumpet), monkey – ooh ooh ah ah, lion – roar: the standard toddler animal sounds. Exactly one animal in shots 1–3, exactly three in shots 4–5. No text/signs.
learning.modeling: Animals stay behind the zoo fence, Ava never touches them; she copies sounds and actions happily.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, bright sunny zoo, baby animals cute and round, the lion roar tiny and friendly, big face.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: the baby elephant pops up beside her face
copy-me: scratch your head like a monkey, lion paws
interactive pause: Who says toot, toot?

story_order.note: copy-me cuts at 15–18 s reuse shot 2 (monkey only) – allowed, nothing appears early. f2 retry (f2-r1) rejected: a lion cub in the background before its moment.
